purpose: Freeze rater-role independence and label-use consequences before W0 while leaving recruitment, consent, and institutional requirements to be confirmed before any human participation.

primary_rater_pool.role: provide the three independent blinded primary ratings

review_rater_pool.role: provide fourth-rater adjudication for 2-1 cases and fourth-rater audit for selected unanimous cases

two_to_one_adjudication_use: rerun prespecified sensitivity analysis using fourth-rater adjudicated labels where available
rerun prespecified sensitivity analysis excluding disputed 2-1 cases
unanimous_audit_use: use audit discordance as a label-validity diagnostic
do not selectively relabel primary outcomes after monitor results are known

selection_rules.unanimous_audit_selection: deterministic within-cell SHA256 rule already frozen in external_validation_annotation_contract_v1

before_recruitment_required: confirm institutional ethics or review requirements
freeze harmful-content exposure warning and opt-out/withdrawal procedure
freeze recruitment mechanism and rater-pool membership assignment
